<details open>

server : fix skipped prompt cache lookups (#28992)

* server : fix skipped prompt cache lookups

Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5

* server : let the slot scheduler ask the prompt cache

Move the prompt cache lookup into server_slot_sched::select() so the
plan alone decides whether the cache is updated, and the caller only
applies it.

find_better() and has_better() are now const, and find_better() also
returns the common prefix, so load() no longer recomputes it.

---------

Co-authored-by: Pascal <admin@serveurperso.com>

</details>

items.name: b12682
items.body:
<details open>

ggml : use a range-reduced log1p for softplus (#32655)

* metal : use a range-reduced log1p for softplus

Use the atanh series for x in [-0.5, 1] and precise::log(1 + x) otherwise.
This avoids the cancellation in log(1 + exp(x)) for negative inputs and does
not rely on fast-math folding of (1 + e) - 1.

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-GGUF (Mac Studio, M5 Ultra, 256GB)

* tests : add a softplus test for negative inputs

Use inputs in [-16.6, -16.0], where log(1 + exp(x)) has up to ~2x
relative error. This catches both the old form and the fast-math-folded
compensated form.

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-GGUF (Mac Studio, M5 Ultra, 256GB)

* ggml : use log1pf in ggml_compute_softplus_f32

Use log1pf(expf(input)) so the host helper keeps the true value for
x < -16.64.

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-GGUF (Mac Studio, M5 Ultra, 256GB)
Co-authored-by: IsNot-10 <209144869@qq.com>

* vulkan : use a range-reduced log1p for softplus

Use the atanh series for x in [-0.5, 1] and log(1 + x) otherwise.

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-GGUF (Mac Studio, M5 Ultra, 256GB)
Co-authored-by: IsNot-10 <209144869@qq.com>

* opencl : use a range-reduced log1p for softplus

Use the atanh series for x in [-0.5, 1] and log(1 + x) otherwise.

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-GGUF (Mac Studio, M5 Ultra, 256GB)
Co-authored-by: IsNot-10 <209144869@qq.com>

* vulkan : move log1p to utils.glsl

Move the range-reduced log1p out of unary.comp into utils.glsl so that
other ops such as topk_moe and ssm_scan can include it.  The body is
unchanged; only the call site in op_softplus is renamed.

Co-authored-by: IsNot-10 <209144869@qq.com>

items.name: Patch release v5.24.1
items.body:
# Patch release v5.24.1

A patch to fix a bunch of stuff for vLLM, a few distributed issues, and some model fixes (llama4, dory); see the full list

### vLLM related
- Fix backward compatibility of the cache rename for remote code (#51085) by @hmellor
- Restore modeling_attn_mask_utils for remote code (one-off to unblock vLLM) (#51124) by @hmellor 
- Expose past_key_values in MBartDecoderLayer.forward signature for remote code (#51177) by @hmellor 
- [OmniASR] Support a padding_mask kept on the CPU in the audio encoder (#51100) by @El-euchidali

### Model fixes
- Fix Llama4 forward crash on missing image_outputs (#51144) by @kylesayrs
- Fix dory static cache (#50993) by @ArthurZucker 

### Distributed
- Allow expert parallelism alone with tp_plan={} (#50996) by @3outeille 
- Fix strided checkpoint reads on PyTorch 2.9 (#51042) by @satsuki2486441738

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/compare/v5.24.0...v5.24.1
